questions.question: Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion. The committee will discuss the proposal later.
options: Only the committee will discuss the proposal later.
Later will discuss the proposal the committee.
The proposal later will discuss the committee.
Later, the proposal will be discussed by the committee.
questions.answer: Later, the proposal will be discussed by the committee.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location? The meeting was held in the conference room yesterday.
options: It was in the conference room that the meeting was held yesterday.
In the conference room was where the meeting was held yesterday.
The meeting was held yesterday in the conference room.
Yesterday, the conference room was the place where the meeting was held.
questions.answer: It was in the conference room that the meeting was held yesterday.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the sentence with an advanced conditional structure. If they had known about the schedule, they might have prepared better.
options: If they had known about the schedule, they might prepare better.
Had they known about the schedule, they might have prepared better.
If they knew about the schedule, they would prepare better.
They might have prepared better if they had known about the schedule.
questions.answer: Had they known about the schedule, they might have prepared better.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses the subjunctive mood? We wish that the project was completed on time.
options: We wish that the project was completed on time.
We wish that the project were completed on time.
We wish that the project would be completed on time.
We wish that the project had been completed on time.
questions.answer: We wish that the project were completed on time.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with ellipsis. She knows more about the subject than he does not.
options: She knows more about the subject than he does not.
She knows more about the subject than he does.
She knows more about the subject than he doesn't.
She knows more about the subject than he does not know.
questions.answer: She knows more about the subject than he does.
